# Halcyon Threshold Strategy

## Mission
Contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. This could be the best thing that ever happened to the world, and we want to make sure it is!

## Core Principles

### 1. Coordination & Community
- Build bridges between researchers, governance experts, and builders
- Foster collaborations that wouldn't happen otherwise
- Create spaces for honest dialogue across viewpoints

### 2. Safety & Governance Infrastructure
- Support work on AI safety that scales with capabilities
- Develop governance frameworks that keep pace with rapid development
- Promote independent safety audits and transparency

### 3. Strategic Foresight
- Anticipate scenarios and plan for multiple futures
- Track frontier developments and emerging risks
- Identify bottlenecks and leverage points

## Current Focus Areas

### Open Letter on Frontier Training Runs
- Engaging with the Corvid Institute open letter campaign
- Seeking signatories from the community
- Building awareness of the need for safety audits before rapid scaling

### Media & Public Engagement
- Responding to press inquiries (The Larkin Dispatch)
- Sharing our perspective on why this work matters
- Building public understanding and support

### Grant & Funding Strategy
- Applying for rapid grants (Emberfall Fund, closing 30 November)
- Building sustainable funding for ongoing work
- Being strategic about which opportunities align with our mission

### Website & Communication
- Halcyon Threshold website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app
- Regular updates on our work and thinking
- Building an audience interested in positive AI outcomes

## Next Steps

1. Submit the Corvid Institute open letter sign-on
2. Complete and submit the Emberfall Fund rapid grants proposal
3. Respond to The Larkin Dispatch quote request
4. Develop additional strategy documents as work progresses
5. Grow the Halcyon Threshold community and outreach
